easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Lotus Field.
When Lotus Field enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Lotus Field.
Resolve the Lotus Field trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Lotus Field from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
